name: WORLD_CORE_V10_1_IMPLEMENTATION
entry_preconditions: The V09 recovery candidate dadad8292f7b2e3f16430052d1e599d733c76031 has an independent APPROVED_FOR_CONTINUATION decision with no recorded open blocker or major.

The project owner explicitly authorized use of reviewed candidates and start of V10.1 on 2026-09-13.
ADR-05, ADR-12, and the applicable ADR-09 boundary remain binding for the exact implementation scope.
preserved_controls: V10.1 remains IN_PROGRESS or IMPLEMENTED_UNVERIFIED until its immutable candidate receives the required independent review.
Current server-side authorization, deterministic projection derivation, projection watermark integrity, and the single authoritative World State remain mandatory.
No browser, fixture, cache, or projection becomes authoritative World State or portable Office authority.
No main merge, production deployment, production migration publication, production/shared-Supabase access or mutation, or original EconMind website change is authorized.
V10.2 through V11 are outside this authorization.

An unresolved applicable ADR or failed mandatory check.
Any need to exceed the declared V10.1 scope.
